correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the eight universal equations BB=B, DD=D, NNN=N, BDBD=BD, DBDB=DB, BN=ND, DNN=NBN and DNB=NB, with the last two invoking Pacheco up-downset and confluence lemmas. Their contextual congruence yields an explicit complete table of 35 representatives closed under all 105 prefixed-generator actions; induction covers every word. Independently rebuilt the bounded congruence closure of 29524 words of length <=9, checked all 105 actions, and evaluated the 35 reps in five displayed two-to-four-world birelational witness models, yielding 35 distinct signature vectors. All eight identities held on the witness valuations; these finite models provide the lower bound only, while sound universal equations supply the upper bound.
